name: product-contact-card
prompt: Screen: a contact card, with "Contacts" highlighted in the sidebar. A small "← Back" link. Title "Great Lakes Freight Co." with the subtitle "Dana Whitfield · Logistics manager". Tags: "In progress", rating chip "A", "Lead gen · Google Maps". Top right: an outlined button "Stop dialing" and a "…" button. Left column of stacked panels: "What's next" with a task row "The system will call — cascade Rating A, touch 2 — Tomorrow, 9:15 AM CT" and a muted link "Show closed (3)"; "Dialing and calls" with "Cascade Rating A · 3 touches · dialing in progress" and two call rows "Conversation happened · 2 min 41 s — asked for a quote on Chicago → Dallas, 3 loads a week" and "Picked up, no conversation · 18 s", plus a link "All calls (4)"; "Loads" with three compact rows "CHI → DAL · Dry van · 42,000 lb · Covered · Carrier: Northline Transport", "CHI → ATL · Reefer · Booking · Carrier: pending", "MKE → HOU · Flatbed · Quote sent"; "History · 14 events" with a note field "Note about the contact". Right column panels: "Contact details" with rows Phone +1 (312) 555-0147, Email, Position Logistics manager, City Chicago, IL, Segment Food & beverage, Manager "Sarah Collins" shown as a small button, Created Sep 12, 2026, Source card: Google Maps; and "What we know about the client" with rows "Loads per month 12–15", "Contact quality Decision maker", "Lane match Chicago → Dallas", "Stop factors None", "Clarified Sep 15, 2026". Render it as a crisp, pixel-perfect desktop web-app screenshot, flat and straight-on, with no browser chrome, no device frame, no perspective and no watermark. Product: "MagnaQore Logistic", an AI calling and sales system for North American freight companies. Dark theme: page background deep warm charcoal #141311; panels and cards #1d1b18 with hairline borders #2c2925 and 12px rounded corners; primary text warm off-white #ece8e1; secondary text muted warm grey #8f8a82; one accent, amber-gold #e9a23b, used for the active navigation marker, count badges, primary buttons, progress fills, active tabs and toggles; green #3fae7a only for positive statuses; lead ratings shown as small rounded chips reading A, B, C or D. Typography: a clean geometric sans-serif similar to Manrope, calm spacing, 13–15px interface text that is sharp, legible and spelled correctly. Left sidebar about 230px wide: a small muted label "MagnaQore" above the bold product name "Logistic AI" with a bell icon; navigation with thin line icons in this order: Dashboard (small amber count badge), Contacts, Dialer, Calls, Chats, Lead gen, Assistant, Settings, Help, System; at the bottom a user block "Alex Morgan" with the role "Sales ops" and a log-out icon. All people, companies, phone numbers and figures are fictional; phone numbers use the US 555 range. English only.
